specializations.title: Huawei HCIA Networking
specializations.shortDesc: Enterprise dynamic routing (OSPF/BGP), VLAN trunking, subnet allocation, and switch security policies.
specializations.detailedScope: Deep technical expertise in enterprise network architecture design. Proficient in configuring Huawei VRP operating systems, setting up multi-area OSPF routing, configuring BGP peering, inter-VLAN trunking, Spanning Tree Protocols (STP/RSTP), and Network Access Control Lists (ACLs).
specializations.practicalApplication: Engineered multi-tier enterprise network layouts with high-availability redundancy and failover routing.

specializations.title: Hikvision CCTV & IP Surveillance
specializations.shortDesc: Digital IP camera architectures, NVR channel setup, PoE switching, and remote cloud video monitoring.
specializations.detailedScope: End-to-end engineering of intelligent physical surveillance ecosystems. Includes IP camera addressing, Network Video Recorder (NVR/DVR) channel setup, RAID storage optimization, ONVIF stream integration, thermal motion sensing, and Hik-Connect cloud gateway integration.
specializations.practicalApplication: Deployed high-density surveillance layouts for commercial facilities with 24/7 retention and remote mobile streaming.

specializations.title: INSA Secure Software Engineering
specializations.shortDesc: Building resilient web microservices, RESTful APIs, database schema design, and security audit telemetry.
specializations.detailedScope: Comprehensive mastery of full-stack web software engineering with an emphasis on security best practices. Experience in designing decoupled React frontends, Express.js REST/GraphQL backends, PostgreSQL relational schemas, and analyzing server audit logs.
competencies: React Component Lifecycle & Hook State Architecture
Node.js & Express RESTful API Middleware Design
System Log Telemetry & Threat Surface Hardening
specializations.practicalApplication: Constructed secure administrative web portals and real-time backend microservices with encrypted data pipelines.

experience.practicalApplication: Engineered production web applications with 99.9% uptime.

experience.shortDesc: Leading developer bootcamps, coordinating hackathons, and mentoring 200+ tech students.
experience.fullDescription: As Tech Lead at GDG AASTU, I spearhead university developer workshops, hands-on coding bootcamps, and technical speaker sessions. Coordinated multi-day hackathons and mentored student development teams building production web applications.
keyAchievements: Organized 12+ tech workshops on React, Node.js, and Cloud deployment.
Mentored over 200 student developers across campus hackathons.
Engineered community event registration systems with real-time analytics.
experience.practicalApplication: Spearheaded technical development programs and campus hackathons directly impacting over 200 developers.

experience.shortDesc: Developing enterprise backend REST APIs, SQL database indexing, and client web dashboards.
experience.fullDescription: Contributed directly to client-facing web application development. Refactored Node.js Express backend API endpoints for accelerated payload delivery, optimized SQL database query execution times, and designed responsive client interfaces.
keyAchievements: Reduced SQL query latency by 25% through strategic indexing.
Integrated JWT user authentication and RBAC authorization pipelines.
Delivered pixel-perfect React interface components from Figma wireframes.
experience.practicalApplication: Engineered scalable REST microservices handling authenticated client operations with 25% lower SQL latency.

experience.shortDesc: Security auditing, system log telemetry analysis, and network threat surface mitigation.
experience.fullDescription: Engaged in critical security auditing, system telemetry monitoring, and vulnerability assessments. Analyzed server event logs to identify operational anomalies, evaluated network perimeter defenses, and assisted in drafting server hardening policies.
keyAchievements: Analyzed server log streams to identify and remediate configuration bugs.
Formulated baseline security guidelines for internal Linux server deployments.
Monitored network telemetry traffic using Wireshark and protocol tools.
experience.practicalApplication: Analyzed live network traffic flows and performed security hardening on enterprise server distributions.

experience.shortDesc: Engineering community event portals, member management databases, and notification services.
experience.fullDescription: Designed and built custom administrative web platforms for community management. Engineered web portals enabling team leaders to maintain member rosters, schedule upcoming events, and dispatch automated announcements.
keyAchievements: Built responsive web portals serving campus community members.
Implemented automated event reminder pipelines and broadcast notifications.
Designed database models ensuring high uptime during traffic surges.
experience.practicalApplication: Designed highly reliable event notification architecture serving community members with 99.9% uptime.

projects.title: Digital Kuralew Platform
projects.shortDesc: On-demand recyclables collection & waste management service platform.
projects.fullDesc: A web platform connecting households with urban recyclable waste collectors in real-time. Features interactive collection scheduling, geographical location tagging, automated pickup pricing estimates, and real-time status tracking for collectors.
architectureHighlights: Real-time geographical location mapping for pickup dispatch.
Role-based portal for household users and municipal collection agents.
projects.practicalApplication: Connects city residents directly with recyclers, reducing municipal landfill loads by over 30 tons monthly.

projects.title: Parking Spot Finder API
projects.shortDesc: Smart urban parking spot reservation API with real-time sensor integration.
projects.fullDesc: A high-concurrency microservice backend for finding and reserving urban parking spaces. Ingests occupancy telemetry from simulated lot sensors, updates available spot counts in real-time via WebSockets, and manages reservation timeouts.
architectureHighlights: WebSocket server streaming live slot availability to mobile clients.
Redis caching layer preventing race conditions during concurrent booking.
Geospatial SQL queries searching available spots within a radius.
projects.practicalApplication: Simulates 50+ smart parking bays with millisecond slot state synchronization and automated expiry reservations.

projects.title: TeleCare+ Telemedicine Portal
projects.shortDesc: Real-time doctor appointment booking & patient records management portal.
projects.fullDesc: A modern healthcare portal providing web-based doctor appointments, digital prescription storage, and secure patient-doctor messaging. Features high-encryption record storage compliant with medical privacy standards.
architectureHighlights: Encrypted patient medical history record storage.
Real-time consultation chat with file attachment support.
projects.practicalApplication: Enables remote consultation booking for clinics with zero scheduling overlap and encrypted patient files.

projects.title: CCTV & IP Network Telemetry
projects.shortDesc: Real-time enterprise network node tracking & IP camera uptime monitor.
projects.fullDesc: An infrastructure dashboard engineered for network operations centers (NOCs). Continuously pings network gateways, Hikvision NVR nodes, and IP cameras, outputting latency graphs and triggering automated offline alerts.
architectureHighlights: Ping latency telemetry tracking with live Chart.js graphs.
Instant WebSocket alerts when CCTV camera streams go offline.
Network topology visual map showing active vs unreachable subnets.
projects.practicalApplication: Ensures zero unnoticed surveillance downtime across 32 continuous IP camera streams.

projects.title: E-Commerce Microservices Engine
projects.shortDesc: Scalable modular API with inventory control and payment webhooks.
projects.fullDesc: A decoupled backend service architecture built for high-throughput online store applications. Features decoupled services for user accounts, product catalogs, shopping cart sessions, and payment gateway webhooks.
architectureHighlights: Microservice boundary separation for order processing and inventory.
JWT token authentication with refresh token rotation.
Automated transactional email receipts via Nodemailer.
projects.practicalApplication: Handles concurrent inventory locks and checkout order processing with dual JWT authentication.

projects.title: Surveillance Storage & Bandwidth Calc
projects.shortDesc: Utility web app calculating CCTV video bitrate and HDD storage requirements.
projects.fullDesc: A technical web calculator designed for security installation engineers. Computes required NVR hard drive storage space and network bandwidth based on video codecs (H.265+, H.264), camera resolution, frame rates, and retention period.
architectureHighlights: Mathematical bitrate estimations for H.265+, H.265, and H.264 compression.
Visual breakdown of terabytes required per NVR camera channel.
Exportable PDF summary reports for client installation proposals.
projects.practicalApplication: Speeds up CCTV project estimation times from hours to under 2 minutes for system integrators.
